app.name: DeepSeek Harness
app.description: DeepSeek's open-source (MIT) agent harness app, run via npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web or desktop builds, with a third-party plugin ecosystem.

observations.note: Page read in full via Tavily extract on 2026-11-12 (Yicai Global, Nov 6): 'DeepSeek Harness had 1.54 million DAUs on its official application programming interface over the week ended Nov. 4, up from 429,000 over the week ended Oct. 7 and 271,000 over the one ended Sept. 30, Hangzhou-based DeepSeek said yesterday.' All three are stated on the same basis (DAU on the official API, over a week), so they are comparable with the 1.54M figure already recorded for Nov 4. Dated to the stated week-end date. No growth rate derived.
